title: One Picture Book Two Vol 54: The Shipwreck

description.main: A short sequence of photographs, some unpublished, from Francesca Todde's long study of the Sicilian writer Goliarda Sapienza.
description.extended:
A short sequence of photographs, some unpublished, from Francesca Todde's long study of the Sicilian writer Goliarda Sapienza and the Mediterranean landscape she came from.

Sapienza (Catania, 1924 – Gaeta, 1996) was a writer, actress, and feminist, known today for the semi-autobiographical novel The Art of Joy. Todde spent years following her life and places, work that produced the book IUZZA. Goliarda Sapienza (Départ Pour l'Image, 2024). The Shipwreck gathers 17 duotone plates from the edges of that project and reads as a set of visual notes. It is number 54 in Nazraeli Press's One Picture Book Two series, made in collaboration with Micamera in an edition of 500 numbered copies, each with a signed 5x7 inch print.

Todde (b. 1981, Italy) is a photographer and publisher based in Milan who co-directs the imprint Départ Pour l'Image. Her projects deal with place, memory, text, and landscape, and usually take the form of books. IUZZA was shortlisted at Arles and PhotoEspaña and received a special mention at the 2025 Bob Calle Prize.
